dog.description_text:
Since I'm a long stay pup, my adoption fee has been reduced! Visit me today to find out my favorite treats and how you can take me home!

My foster writes:
Cuppy is an adorable playful puppy who just wants to show you much love he has to give! He already loves our cats and enjoys playing chase with our two resident dogs. He plays so hard (and throws his stuffies in the air and catches them!) that he often knocks himself out and just falls asleep where ever he lands!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I am playful and cute!

I have medical needs that staff will address with you when you meet me.
dog.name: Cuppy
